key_decisions.decision: Keeps Aaron alone as in the pinned text, the lamp’s location outside the curtain, and the testimony designation.
Preserves pure as the stated adjective without silently inserting gold or making the ritual condition certain.
Uses arrangement to avoid deciding whether maarakot means rows or stacks, retaining both counts and pure.
Makes frankincense the memorial portion rather than implying that the priests’ bread is burned; with does not fix its exact placement.
Preserves Name and the two verbal actions, with a note on naqav’s uncertain force; retains mother, grandfather and tribe.
Preserves the hearers’ participation and the whole assembly’s execution, without inventing a symbolic explanation for the hand-laying.
Retains the possessive his God and guilt-bearing language, with a note on the possible broader divine reference.
Keeps both death declarations, communal stoning and equal application to foreigner and native-born; does not broaden this into every legal status.
Makes the fatal force of striking a human life explicit rather than prescribing death for any nonfatal blow.
Renders inflicted mum as bodily injury here while retaining the reciprocal physical wording without substituting later compensation rules.
Preserves the three paired injuries and the repeated matching-injury statement, not a generalized fairness maxim.
Keeps the single legal standard in this context without importing an assertion that all distinctions elsewhere are abolished.
